name: Gielda Papierów Wartosciowych w Warszawie S.A.
summary: Gielda Papierów Wartosciowych w Warszawie S.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates a stock exchange in Poland. It operates through Financial, Commodity, and Other segments. The company trades in equities; equity-related financial instruments; other cash markets instruments, such as structured products, investment certificates, and exchange traded fund units; derivatives; corporate, municipal, co-operative, treasury, and mortgage bonds; debt instruments; and agricultural commodities, as well as provides listing, trading, clearing services for shares and bonds, and information services.
